root_cause.text: The X.509 extension parser in `x509_process_extension()` reads the first byte (`v[0]`) of Basic Constraints and Key Usage extension values before verifying the value length (`vlen`), causing an out-of-bounds access when the extension is empty (length 0 or insufficient).
root_cause.evidence: The patch swaps the order of the length check (`vlen < 4` or `vlen < 2`) with the byte type check (`v[0] != ASN1_BTS` or `v[0] != ASN1_CONS_BIT | ASN1_SEQ`), ensuring the length is validated before any dereference. The CVE description explicitly states "the first byte of the extension is read before checking its length."

intent_record.intent_summary: Reorder checks to validate buffer length before accessing its first byte, preventing a potential out-of-bounds read.
intent_record.what: Swapped the order of two condition checks in x509_process_extension: moved the check for vlen < 4 before the check for v[0] != ASN1_BTS.
intent_record.how: Ensures that the buffer length is verified to be at least 4 before accessing v[0], preventing a potential out-of-bounds read when vlen is less than 4.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reorder checks to validate vlen before accessing v[0] to prevent out-of-bounds access in x509_process_extension.
intent_record.what: Swapped the order of two checks in x509_process_extension: moved the vlen < 2 check before the v[0] ASN1 tag check.
intent_record.how: Ensures that v[0] is only accessed after confirming vlen is at least 2, preventing a potential out-of-bounds read when the extension data is too short.
